import os,json,pathlib,subprocess,datetime,urllib.parse
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/as/Ai-Project/project/AreaForge')
out=root/'output/dependency-audit/dep-1'
env={k:os.environ[k] for k in ['PATH','HOME','USER','LOGNAME','SHELL'] if k in os.environ}
tmp=out/'tmp';tmp.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env.update({'TMPDIR':str(tmp)+'/', 'CI':'true','NO_COLOR':'1','NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED':'1','DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH':'/dev/null','npm_config_userconfig':'/dev/null','DATABASE_URL':'postgresql://dep1:synthetic@127.0.0.1:1/dep1_no_database','AUTH_SESSION_SECRET':'dep1-synthetic-session-secret-at-least-32-bytes','APP_ENV':'test','APP_URL':'http://localhost:3000'})
# Node 层把真实环境文件视为不存在；macOS sandbox 同时拒绝文件读取。
guard="""import fs from 'node:fs';import {syncBuiltinESMExports} from 'node:module';import path from 'node:path';const hidden=p=>{try{const n=path.basename(String(p));return n==='.env'||(n.startsWith('.env.')&&n!=='.env.example')}catch{return false}};for(const k of ['statSync','readFileSync','openSync']){const orig=fs[k];fs[k]=function(p,...a){if(hidden(p)){if(k==='statSync')return orig.call(this,'/dev/null',...a);const e=new Error('DEP1_ENV_FILE_EXCLUDED');e.code='ENOENT';throw e}return orig.call(this,p,...a)}}syncBuiltinESMExports();"""
env['NODE_OPTIONS']='--import=data:text/javascript,'+urllib.parse.quote(guard,safe='')
profile='(version 1)(allow default)(deny file-read-data (regex "/[.]env([.](local|production|development|test)([.]local)?)?$"))'
if not payload.get('network',False):profile+='(deny network-outbound)'
cmd=['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec','-p',profile]+payload['cmd']
start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
with open(out/(payload['id']+'.log'),'wb') as log:
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root/payload.get('cwd','.'),env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
rec={'command':payload['cmd'],'cwd':str(root/payload.get('cwd','.')),'start':start,'end':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'exitCode':p.returncode,'networkOutboundDenied':not payload.get('network',False),'envFilesExcluded':True,'log':payload['id']+'.log'}
(out/(payload['id']+'-result.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rec,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in rec.items() if k!='command'}))
print((out/(payload['id']+'.log')).read_text(errors='replace')[-4000:])
scope: 仅 pnpm install/audit 允许 registry 网络；check/测试/静态验证均由 macOS sandbox 拒绝出站连接。只继承基础 PATH/HOME/USER/LOGNAME/SHELL，以合成 DATABASE_URL/会话配置运行。DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null；真实环境文件在 Node 层不可读，macOS 同时拒绝对应文件内容读取。

buildIpcAdjustment.reason: Turbopack 的生成 PostCSS 子进程从 apps/web/.next/build/chunks/pool_entry-* 启动，argv[2] 指定本批 loopback IPC 端口。OS 拒绝非 loopback 出站；Node Socket.connect 只允许该构建目录子进程连接其 argv[2] 指定的 127.0.0.1 端口，其他连接均同步拒绝；真实 env 文件仍被排除。
buildIpcAdjustment.priorBuildFailure: check-verified.log 记录全网禁止导致 PostCSS IPC 失败；build-ipc.log 记录 sandbox host 语法拒绝；改用 localhost profile 后 build-ipc-localhost 退出 0。
